item.title: RT: 哇。斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 扭转了他过去两周的整个攻击路线，宣称他负责中国
item.description:
哇。斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 扭转了他过去两周的整个攻击路线，宣称他负责中国贸易政策，而不是商务部，他现在同意总统的观点，并不认为将中国列入黑名单是明智之举，“我们不想脱钩，我们想消除风险”，支持卢特尼克推动 NVIDIA 自我监管芯片销售的做法，而不是在司法部秘密调查期间通过黑名单向目标泄露信息。

这与他最近几周向媒体宣传的内容截然不同，他指责卢特尼克的对华政策，并批评商务部没有与中国脱钩。这里非常奇怪的翻转……想知道在中国之行期间进行了哪些对话让他像这样改变了路线？

Wow. Scott Bessent just reverses his entire line of attack from the last 2 weeks, declaring HE is responsible for China trade policy, not Commerce, and that he now agrees with the President and doesn’t believe it’s wise to blacklist China “we don’t want to decouple, we want to derisk”, endorsing Lutnick’s approach of pushing NVIDIA to self-police chip sales without tipping off the targets with a blacklist in the middle of a clandestine DOJ investigation.

This is a complete 180 from what he’d been pitching to media outlets in recent weeks, blaming Lutnick for China policy and criticizing Commerce for not decoupling from China. Very odd flip flop here…wonder what conversations were had during that China trip for him to change course like this?

item.title: 🚨 德鲁肯米勒表示能见度很低——他的作品集已经开始体现这一点 “我不记得有哪一次我对
item.description:
🚨 德鲁肯米勒表示能见度很低——他的作品集已经开始体现这一点

“我不记得有哪一次我对 12 个月后的目标如此清晰。” — 斯坦利·德鲁肯米勒

他对第三季度的定位似乎与这种谨慎态度一致。

我们的数据显示，德鲁肯米勒在第三季度将美国股票敞口减少了约 5 亿美元。

据报道，他的美国股票投资组合仍约为 4B 美元——这是我们历史数据中的第三高水平。

这是一个有趣的比较：

➡️ 他目前持有约 4B 美元的美国股票敞口，与 2021 年第二季度的规模大致相同。

2021 年第二季度之后，他在接下来的四个季度中逐步减少了该风险敞口，最终到 2022 年第二季度达到约 $1.4B。

这并不意味着相同的模式会重复。

但他最近的言论+第三季度首次有意义的削减使得历史平行值得关注。

📉 德鲁肯米勒似乎变得更加谨慎。

🚨 Druckenmiller Says Visibility Is Low — and His Portfolio Is Starting to Show It

“I can’t remember a period where I had less clarity on where we’re gonna be in 12 months.” — Stanley Druckenmiller

His Q3 positioning appears consistent with that caution.

Our data shows Druckenmiller reduced U.S. equity exposure by roughly $500M in Q3.

His reported U.S. equity portfolio still stands at about $4B — the 3rd-highest level in our historical data.

Here’s the interesting comparison:

➡️ His current ~$4B U.S. equity exposure is roughly the same size as it was in Q2 2021.

After Q2 2021, he progressively reduced that exposure over the following four quarters, eventually reaching just ~$1.4B by Q2 2022.

That does not mean the same pattern will repeat.

But his recent comments + the first meaningful Q3 reduction make the historical parallel worth watching.

📉 Druckenmiller appears to be turning more cautious.

@wallstengine

斯坦利德鲁肯米勒在市场上：

“我不记得有哪一个时期我对 12 个月后我们的目标如此清晰。”

“我们是在保本，努力不赔钱，而不是赚钱。”

“我们不做多股票，也不做空股票。”

“我真的很警惕，27 年下半年的经济状况可能会令人失望。”

“我不敢对正在进行的所有创新做空。”

“这些股票已经超卖，已经被淘汰。我们有一些小仓位，但我们基本上会远离。”

我们做空铜，“美联储没有降息，而是加息。”

“我不打球。当我热的时候我会打大球，当我冷的时候我会打小短打。”

STANLEY DRUCKENMILLER ON THE MARKET:

"I can't remember a period where I had less clarity on where we're gonna be in 12 months."

"We're in capital preservation, trying to not lose money as opposed to make money."

"We're not long equities & we're not short."

"I'm really alert to the fact that the second half of '27 could be economically disappointing."

"I wouldn't dare go short with all the innovation going on."

"Those stocks are oversold, they're washed out. We have some small positions but we're basically staying away."

We are short Copper, “The Fed is not cutting, they’re hiking.”

"I'm not playing. I play big when I'm hot, when I'm cold I do little bunts."

item.title: RT: NVIDIA 董事会失去了远见吗？黄仁勋创建了历史上最成功的公司之一，帮助改变了人工智
item.description:
NVIDIA 董事会失去了远见吗？黄仁勋创建了历史上最成功的公司之一，帮助改变了人工智能创新，并为股东和 Nvidia 团队成员创造了非凡的价值。然而，董事会甚至在内部调查完成之前就对他做出了预先判断。为什么要赶走一位有远见的美国创始人？ 这种不听取 NVIDIA 团队成员、股东的意见，也不权衡所有事实而仓促做出判断的行为，引发了严重的问题。董事会需要敞开心扉，立即考虑恢复詹森的职务！

Has NVIDIA’s Board lost perspective? Jensen Huang built one of the most successful companies in history, helped transform AI innovation, and created extraordinary value for shareholders and Nvidia team members. Yet the Board prejudged him even before their own internal investigation was completed. Why push out a visionary American founder? This rush to judgment, without listening to NVIDIA team members, shareholders, or weighing all the facts, raises serious questions. The Board needs to open their minds and consider reinstating Jensen NOW!

item.title: RT: 当被问及英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋表示很荣幸重返公司后是否应该得到第二次机会时，加
item.description:
当被问及英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋表示很荣幸重返公司后是否应该得到第二次机会时，加州州长加文·纽瑟姆称针对黄仁勋的指控“令人难以置信”，但他表示，“在我们了解所有情况之前，我会保留判断。”

纽瑟姆周二在访问国会山时告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻：“我认为我们中的任何人都认为我们中的任何人都知道事实是不正确的。”

Asked whether former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang deserves a second chance after saying he would be honored to return to the company, California Gov. Gavin Newsom called the allegations against Huang “incredibly concerning,” but said, “Until we know all of that, I would reserve judgment.”

“I don't think it's right for any of us to assume any of us know the facts,” Newsom told CBS News during a visit to Capitol Hill on Tuesday.

➡️ $AMD position increased sharply
